VTEQ2fhGLqE-S2-B000.justification: The quote states entry happens if price breaks the line, which is exactly enter-on-trend-line-break.

VTEQ2fhGLqE-S2-B001.justification: The quote says the broken line is the one that tells you to get into the trade, i.e. the break of that line triggers entry.

VTEQ2fhGLqE-S2-B002.justification: The quote flags a two-touch-point line as high risk (a warning about one example), while the condition rewrites it into a requirement that the line MUST have only two touch points.

VTEQ2fhGLqE-S2-B003.justification: The quote directly says the opposing trend line becomes the safety line once the break is taken.
